versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Agent Incident Postmortem skill.
- Provides a structured, blameless postmortem framework for AI/LLM agent incidents (e.g., hallucination, prompt injection, bad autonomous actions).
- Outputs include timeline, trace reconstruction, layered root-cause analysis, and corrective actions (with regression case).
- Distinct process for AI failures — focuses on behaviours, trace evidence, and root-cause layers from input/context to detection.
- Explicit quality checks and anti-patterns to ensure robust, useful analysis (not just "model was wrong" or "improved the prompt").
